articles.summary: 19 October 2026, Shanghai – IHG Hotels & Resorts announced a partnership with American Express in Mainland China, bringing together premium Card Member benefits and IHG’s hotel experiences to deliver more rewarding and exclusive travel experiences for high-value travelers. The partnership will offer eligible American Express® Platinum Cardmembers a complimentary status match to IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status, unlocking a range of exclusive member benefits across more than 7,000 IHG hotels worldwide. Eligible American Express Cardmembers can also enjoy a limited-time cashback offer at participating IHG properties. This collaboration also marks the first time IHG One Rewards has partnered with an international card network on a status match initiative in Mainland China.
articles.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts Partners with American Express to Elevate Premium Travel Experiences for Card Members in Mainland China

articles.summary: TAIPEI, 12 October 2026 – IHG Hotels & Resorts (IHG), one of the world's leading hotel companies, today announces the opening of InterContinental Taipei, marking a significant milestone in the continued growth of its luxury portfolio in the Taiwan market. Developed in partnership with Farglory Group, the hotel represents the partners' second InterContinental collaboration, following InterContinental Kaohsiung. Together with the recently signed Hualien Farglory Hotel, Vignette Collection, these developments further strengthen IHG's growing Luxury & Lifestyle presence in Greater China.
articles.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts Opens InterContinental Taipei, Expanding Luxury Portfolio in Greater China
